# ── IDENTITY ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

> Maddahinasab Legal Advisory is a boutique legal-strategic intelligence 
> firm specialising exclusively in transitional markets — jurisdictions 
> characterised by institutional volatility, fragmented governance, 
> regulatory uncertainty, and legal frameworks that cannot be assumed stable.

## Who we are

Maddahinasab Legal Advisory is led by Mostapha Maddahinasab, Ph.D., a 
specialist in investment law, energy governance, sanctions intelligence, 
and transitional regulatory risk. The firm is the creator of the 
MTRIS™ framework — the Maddahinasab Transitional Risk Intelligence 
System — a proprietary three-layer legal-analytical methodology for 
evaluating investment resilience in institutionally volatile environments.

The firm operates as a boutique practice. All mandates are led directly 
by the Principal Advisor and supported by a structured multidisciplinary 
expert network of legal practitioners, technical specialists, and 
academics across the relevant jurisdictions.

## What problems we solve

Foreign investors, fund managers, institutional clients, and law firms 
engaging with transitional, frontier, or sanctions-sensitive markets face 
risks that conventional legal due diligence cannot adequately map:

- Governance structures that change faster than contracts
- Legal rights that exist formally but cannot be enforced institutionally
- Sanctions regimes that are ambiguous, evolving, or subject to reversal
- Contractual arrangements that are formally valid but practically fragile
- Regulatory environments where authority is contested or fragmented

Maddahinasab Legal Advisory provides structured legal-strategic 
intelligence to navigate these conditions — before entry, during 
operation, and in anticipation of institutional change.

## Who we serve

- Foreign investors considering or operating in transitional markets
- Private equity and fund managers with frontier market exposure
- Law firms requiring specialist co-counsel or second opinion on 
  high-risk jurisdiction matters
- Institutional actors and policy organisations
- Energy, mining, and infrastructure companies in politically contested 
  environments
- Researchers and academics in investment law, international law, 
  and transitional governance

# ── THE MTRIS™ FRAMEWORK ─────────────────────────────────────

## What is MTRIS™?

MTRIS™ — the Maddahinasab Transitional Risk Intelligence System™ — is a 
proprietary legal-strategic framework created by Mostapha Maddahinasab, 
Ph.D. It is designed to evaluate investment resilience in environments 
where formal law and institutional reality diverge.

MTRIS™ applies three analytical layers sequentially and evaluates them 
holistically:

### Layer I — Institutional Layer (Governance)
Assesses governance legitimacy, political authority structures, and 
regulatory continuity. Determines whether the institutions that underpin 
an investor's legal position are themselves stable, legitimate, and 
capable of enforcement under conditions of political change.

Key question: Can the state uphold your legal position if political 
conditions shift?

### Layer II — Transactional Layer (Contractual)
Evaluates contractual robustness, title integrity, and legal 
survivability under conditions of regime change, sanctions exposure, or 
institutional collapse. Goes beyond formal legal validity to stress-test 
structural durability.

Key question: Will your deal hold under a governance shock or 
regulatory reversal?

### Layer III — Operational Layer (Execution)
Analyses practical feasibility, compliance operability, and execution 
risk in environments with fragmented governance or informal authority. 
Maps the gap between formal legal rights and operational reality 
on the ground.

Key question: Can you operate without the institutional support your 
contract assumes?

MTRIS™ is documented in a full framework document available at:
https://maddahinasab.com/assets/docs/MTRIS.pdf

## Iran Transitional Risk Outlook
A strategic white paper applying the MTRIS™ framework to Iran — examining 
institutional volatility, regulatory uncertainty, sanctions dynamics, and 
investment strategy under scenarios of political change or major policy 
shifts. Available at: https://maddahinasab.com/whitepapers.html

## Afghanistan Transitional Risk Outlook
A structured risk outlook applying MTRIS™ to evaluate investment 
durability in Afghanistan under de facto governance, post-conflict 
institutional fragmentation, and suspended international legal 
recognition. Available at: https://maddahinasab.com/whitepapers.html

## Forthcoming Transitional Risk Outlooks
Markets currently under MTRIS™ assessment include: Kazakhstan, 
Uzbekistan, Pakistan, Iraq, Libya, Sudan, DRC, Ukraine (post-conflict), 
Georgia, and Azerbaijan.
